<p> </p>
    <div class="headline">
        <h3>The available PhD scholarship cover</h3>
    </div>
    <ul>
        <li>Tuition fee</li>
        <li>Monthly stipend (RMB 4,500.00)</li>
        <!--<li>Medical insurance with designated providers</li>-->
        <li>All above items are covered for up to 36 months based on satisfactory progression</li>
        <li>All regulations set out in the <a title="UNNC PhD Scholarship Policy" href="/en/graduateschool/documents/phd-scholarship-terms-and-conditions.pdf" target="_blank">PhD Scholarship Terms and Conditions</a> apply</li>
            </ul>
    <p style="text-align: justify">In addition to the above scholarship, successful candidates also have the opportunity to carry out teaching (after the completion of Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) training) or research assistant duties at UNNC since second year of their PhD programmes.</p>
<p> </p>
<div class="headline">
        <h3>Available PhD research areas</h3>
</div>
    <div class="row">
        <div class="col-md-8">
                <div><p>Applicants should seek consent from potential supervisors before submitting an application. For more details, please click '<strong>Available research projects</strong>'.  .</p>
<p><strong>Green </strong><strong>Chemical</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Integrate intelligent and information technology with chemical equipment, and develop remote diagnosis technology for chemical equipment;</li>
<li>Using the concept of green chemical industry to develop chemical and biocatalysis, supercritical fluids, new separation and other technologies;</li>
<li>Green preparation technology of high-end metal and alloy materials based on high-temperature molten salt solid-state deoxidation method;</li>
<li>Research on low-polluting materials (zero-emission water-based coatings);</li>
<li>Green preparation process of graphene materials.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Low-carbon energy</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>New technologies for pyrolysis, combustion and gasification of coal and bioenergy;</li>
<li>Carbon dioxide reuse process based on photocatalysis, chemical catalysis and simulation calculation methods;</li>
<li>Combined removal technology and materials for sulfur, nitro, and mercury in coal-fired power plants;</li>
<li>Clean energy conversion technology based on new high-efficiency renewable catalytic materials;</li>
<li>Development of innovative electrochemical energy storage materials and devices.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Environmental remediation and waste treatment</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Green waste conversion and process intensification technology;</li>
<li>Integrated technologies for the separation and enrichment of high-value materials in e-waste;</li>
<li>New monitoring technologies for environmental pollution, pollution control strategies, and migration and transformation of pollutants between multiple phases and interfaces in the environment.</li>
</ul></div>
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-4">

            <div><a class="CTA-BIG" style="font-size: larger" title="Available research projects" href="/en/GraduateSchool/documents/Research-Area/25ResearchAreas/25CET-0917-2.pdf">Available research projects</a></div>
        </div>
    </div>
<p> </p>
<div class="headline">
  <h3>PhD programme structure</h3>
</div>
    <p style="text-align: justify">PhD programmes at the UNNC are composed of 3 years research and a 1 year thesis pending period for full time PhDs. Full time PhDs are expected to submit their theses within a maximum of four years from initial registration. </p>
    <p style="text-align: justify">On successful completion of the PhD, the students will be awarded a <strong>PhD degree from University of Nottingham</strong>. No reference will be made on the degree certificate as to where the degree has been completed. The University of Nottingham PhD degree is accredited by the Chinese Ministry of Education and the UK Quality Assurance Agency.</p>
<p> </p>
<div class="headline">
  <h3>Eligibility</h3>
</div>
        <div><p>Applicants considering to apply for PhD Scholarship must have met the entry requirements of a PhD programme first. More details can be found on the '<a title="Entry requirements" href="https://www.nottingham.edu.cn/en/graduateschool/prospective-students/entry-requirements.aspx">entry requirements</a>' page of the website.</p>
<p>Applicants must have a master degree with minimum average score of 65% and degree classification Merit or above from a British university. Applicants also should hold a bachelor degree at upper second class or above level. Applicants from institutions where different score system is used must have achieved an equivalent level of performance to the above.</p>
<p>The Faculty of Science and Engineering also considers applicants holding a bachelor’s degree with first class honours from a British university or the equivalent from other prestigious institutions, e.g. double first-class Chinese universities.</p>
<p>Applicants must meet the required English language proficiency for the relevant subject area. IELTS 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in all elements) or its equivalent is required for Faculty of Science and Engineering (FoSE) scholarship applicants.</p>
<p>IELTS test score report or its international equivalent has to be submitted together with the application by the deadline<strong> 31 October 2025</strong>.</p></div>
<p> </p>
<div class="headline">
  <h3>How to apply</h3>
</div>
    <p style="text-align: justify">No separate application is required for applying for a scholarship but please make sure you select the correct scholarship reference number in the PhD application system. A list of required documents can be found on the '<a title="How to apply" href="/en/graduateschool/prospective-students/how-to-apply.aspx">how to apply</a>' page.</p>
